Subtle patches of warm ochre/taupe soil and tiny embedded grains; a few small leaves, very fine understated gravel marks, no separate rock props. Natural irregular low olive/moss grass margins; modest grass fringe at bottom. Ground has readable painted form and subtle depth, never an empty flat solid color or a stone floor. No steps, banks, pits or raised roots.
